The rider's initial identification burden under POL-RD-08(a) is discharged on evidence, not on assertion.

The distance gap must be measured on the governing artifact, and it is a real gap. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measure and expressly bars trip_record.actual_distance_km from the threshold test; the governing figure is 14.39 km against the 12.0 km optimal stored at booking, an excess of 2.39 km, which clears the clause's 0.8 km absolute limb by a factor of three. The trace is clean - 113 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps recorded and a maximum gap of 0 seconds - so no POL-RD-07 discount is available to the driver and 2.39 km is the reliable measured figure, consistent with the driver's own statement that he took a 'minor detour'.

I state the percentage limb as the record has it, not as the rider would prefer it. On the governing trace figure the excess of 2.39 km is 19.92% of the 12.0 km optimal, and POL-RD-01 requires strictly more than 20% - 2.40 km - so the establishment test is missed by 0.01 km. The rider does not ask the Judge to close that gap with the trip_record's rounded 14.4 km copy, which POL-RD-01 bars from the threshold test, and I do not assert a POL-RD-02 recomputation that the establishment test on this measurement does not support. For completeness only, the fare block's own arithmetic would put a recomputed fare at 18.08 against 20.64 charged if the test were met.

The driver's explanation cannot be weighed, because the artifact it would have to rest on is absent. He asserts only a 'road works sign' and names no advisory and no evidence ID; the sole traffic_advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02841-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its own assessment records that no advisory covers the Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 corridor in this window. Under POL-RD-13 that means the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 - an uncited traffic excuse discharges nothing. Nor is there a rider-instruction explanation: EV-CHAT-02841 contains zero messages, so the corroboration POL-RD-04 requires cannot even be attempted. The 2.39 km of extra driving is therefore explained by nothing in the bundle.

No route-adjustment escape is open to the driver on this record either. Pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null, so POL-RD-05 cannot produce an amended optimal route, and vehicle_type is RYDE_X with solo_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not exist on this trip. The booked 12.0 km optimal is the only baseline in the evidence, and the excess must be measured against it.

claims.text: The rider's own numbers cannot clear the policy gate. Against the booked optimal route of 12.0 km, the trace's 14.39 km is an excess of 2.39 km — 19.92% of optimal, which is NOT greater than the 20% POL-RD-01 requires. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is BOTH greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms; the percentage limb fails, so no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. A 2.39 km variation is exactly the ordinary lane change, forced U-turn or short gantry-avoidance distance that the single numeric gate in POL-RD-01 exists to keep out of refundable disputes.

The trace governs this measurement, and both distance fields fail. POL-RD-01 provides that where gps_trace.trace_distance_km and trip_record.actual_distance_km disagree, the trace figure governs and the trip_record copy may not be cited for the threshold test. The trace records 14.39 km, an excess of 19.92%. Even the rounded trip_record convenience copy of 14.4 km yields an excess of exactly 2.40 km, i.e. exactly 20.0% of 12.0 km — still not GREATER than 20%. Reading the larger field does not save the claim; reading the governing field defeats it.

The variation is not merely unestablished, it is nowhere near MATERIAL. POL-RD-01 makes an excess additional MATERIAL only above 50% of optimal or above 8.0 km absolute; the measured 2.39 km is under a third of that absolute figure, so the driver_profile check mandated by POL-RD-06 is not engaged and no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) is available. Were that check run, the citable counters disclose no repeat pattern: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 196, a ratio of zero.

The rider carries the initial burden and has not discharged it. POL-RD-08 requires the rider to show, citing evidence IDs, an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold measured from an unimpaired gps_trace. The undisputed record shows 14.39 km against a 12.0 km optimal — 19.92% — which falls short of the gate. The burden therefore never shifts to the driver, and no exculpatory clause needs to be reached to decide this case.

No clause moves the baseline against which the rider is measuring. The vehicle type is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary basis for pooled trips does not apply and the booked 12.0 km is the correct optimal; pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and no amended optimal exists on the record; and the chat log carries zero messages, so POL-RD-04 has no rider instruction to act on and its corroboration test cannot be met. The comparison the rider himself makes — 14.39 km against 12.0 km — is therefore the correct comparison, and it fails.

The trace the rider relies on is complete and unimpaired for policy purposes. It carries 113 fixes at a 10 s sampling interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so it meets none of the impairment limbs POL-RD-07(a) to (c) sets. Its 14.39 km measurement is reliable exactly as recorded; there is no data failure of the kind that would force escalation under POL-RD-10 on the trace's account, and the arithmetic on which this defence rests is sound.

The one refund route that survives a finding of no deviation yields nothing here. POL-RD-09(4) refunds a charge line for a gantry the trace never passes, or an airport surcharge on a trip that does not originate at an airport, whether or not a deviation exists. On this fare breakdown the charged distance of 14.4 km is the same measurement as the 14.39 km trace and not a phantom line; the erp_lines array is empty and no gantry is charged at all; and no airport surcharge line appears on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. There is no standalone billing-integrity correction to make.

A threshold failure is a win for the driver on this record. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION means the filing party's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands: fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, and nothing in that outcome disturbs the driver's fare. ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your claim is not supported by the evidence, and the charge stands. To the driver: no refund is owed and none is ordered against you either way.

Both sides agree on the measurement, and so do I. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is STRICTLY greater than 20% of the booked optimal distance AND strictly greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms. The governing figure is the trace: gps_trace.trace_distance_km on EV-GPS-02841 is 14.39 km, and POL-RD-01 expressly bars the trip record's rounded 14.4 km copy from the threshold test. The booked optimal on EV-TRIP-02841 is 12.0 km. Excess = 14.39 - 12.0 = 2.39 km, which is 19.92% of 12.0 km. The 20% limb requires more than 2.40 km; the claim misses it by 0.01 km. The absolute limb (2.39 km > 0.8 km) passes, but both limbs must pass, so no deviation is established and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the trip is characterised. POL-RD-08 therefore never shifts the burden to the driver.

The driver's explanation ("Minor detour because of a road works sign") carries no weight and is discarded. POL-RD-13 tests a traffic excuse against a traffic_advisory for this trip, and the only advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02841-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: no advisory covers this corridor in this window. Because the driver named no evidence ID for an advisory, this is not the POL-RD-10(5) escalation case (POL-RD-13(1)); it is an assertion that discharges nothing under POL-RD-08. It changes nothing here in any event, because the case fails at the POL-RD-01 threshold before any excuse is reached.

The trace is clean at both layers. For policy purposes it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c): 113 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0 s. At the schema layer EV-GPS-02841 and EV-TRIP-02841 both carry weight_multiplier 1.0, so no POL-GEN-02 discount and no POL-RD-07 or POL-RD-10(3) consequence follows.

POL-RD-09(4) yields no standalone billing-integrity correction: erp_lines is empty, no airport surcharge line appears, and the billed 14.4 km is the same measurement as the 14.39 km trace rather than a phantom line.

No clause moves the baseline either. vehicle_type is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12's pooled matched-itinerary baseline does not apply (solo_optimal_distance_km is null); pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot produce an amended optimal; and EV-CHAT-02841 carries zero messages, so POL-RD-04 has no rider instruction to test.

No profile field carries this decision. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d = 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated = 0 are below the POL-RD-08 thresholds, so no corroboration beyond the trace was ever required of the rider, and no other profile field was used as a ground, as POL-GEN-01 requires.

Confidence is 0.90. The deciding fact - the 2.39 km / 19.92% excess measured against the 12.0 km optimal - is carried entirely by weight-1.0 artifacts (EV-GPS-02841 and EV-TRIP-02841), so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and no discount applies. The monetary effect is nil, well below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION leaves fare_breakdown.payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 as they stand; the contested SGD 3.50 is not refunded. This ruling is provisional and both parties may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ledger.claim: The artifacts describe one trip, and nothing in the record disputes it: trip_record EV-TRIP-02841, gps_trace EV-GPS-02841 and fare_breakdown EV-FARE-02841 each carry trip_id TRP-02841, and the trace's first and last fixes (2026-08-31T07:57:55+08:00 to 08:16:35+08:00) coincide with the trip_record's started_at and ended_at for the same booking. The rider's initial identification burden under POL-RD-08(a) is discharged on evidence, not on assertion.

The distance gap must be measured on the governing artifact, and it is a real gap. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measure and expressly bars trip_record.actual_distance_km from the threshold test; the governing figure is 14.39 km against the 12.0 km optimal stored at booking, an excess of 2.39 km, which clears the clause's 0.8 km absolute limb by a factor of three. The trace is clean - 113 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps recorded and a maximum gap of 0 seconds - so no POL-RD-07 discount is available to the driver and 2.39 km is the reliable measured figure, consistent with the driver's own statement that he took a 'minor detour'.

I state the percentage limb as the record has it, not as the rider would prefer it. On the governing trace figure the excess of 2.39 km is 19.92% of the 12.0 km optimal, and POL-RD-01 requires strictly more than 20% - 2.40 km - so the establishment test is missed by 0.01 km. The rider does not ask the Judge to close that gap with the trip_record's rounded 14.4 km copy, which POL-RD-01 bars from the threshold test, and I do not assert a POL-RD-02 recomputation that the establishment test on this measurement does not support. For completeness only, the fare block's own arithmetic would put a recomputed fare at 18.08 against 20.64 charged if the test were met.

The driver's explanation cannot be weighed, because the artifact it would have to rest on is absent. He asserts only a 'road works sign' and names no advisory and no evidence ID; the sole traffic_advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02841-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its own assessment records that no advisory covers the Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 corridor in this window. Under POL-RD-13 that means the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 - an uncited traffic excuse discharges nothing. Nor is there a rider-instruction explanation: EV-CHAT-02841 contains zero messages, so the corroboration POL-RD-04 requires cannot even be attempted. The 2.39 km of extra driving is therefore explained by nothing in the bundle.

No route-adjustment escape is open to the driver on this record either. Pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null, so POL-RD-05 cannot produce an amended optimal route, and vehicle_type is RYDE_X with solo_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not exist on this trip. The booked 12.0 km optimal is the only baseline in the evidence, and the excess must be measured against it.

The rider's profile raises no additional hurdle to this claim and no profile field is used as a ground of decision. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, both below the 4-and-1 thresholds POL-RD-08 sets, so no corroboration beyond the gps_trace is required of the rider here; no other profile field on either party is relied on, as POL-GEN-01 requires.

The rider's own numbers cannot clear the policy gate. Against the booked optimal route of 12.0 km, the trace's 14.39 km is an excess of 2.39 km — 19.92% of optimal, which is NOT greater than the 20% POL-RD-01 requires. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is BOTH greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms; the percentage limb fails, so no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. A 2.39 km variation is exactly the ordinary lane change, forced U-turn or short gantry-avoidance distance that the single numeric gate in POL-RD-01 exists to keep out of refundable disputes.

The trace governs this measurement, and both distance fields fail. POL-RD-01 provides that where gps_trace.trace_distance_km and trip_record.actual_distance_km disagree, the trace figure governs and the trip_record copy may not be cited for the threshold test. The trace records 14.39 km, an excess of 19.92%. Even the rounded trip_record convenience copy of 14.4 km yields an excess of exactly 2.40 km, i.e. exactly 20.0% of 12.0 km — still not GREATER than 20%. Reading the larger field does not save the claim; reading the governing field defeats it.

The variation is not merely unestablished, it is nowhere near MATERIAL. POL-RD-01 makes an excess additional MATERIAL only above 50% of optimal or above 8.0 km absolute; the measured 2.39 km is under a third of that absolute figure, so the driver_profile check mandated by POL-RD-06 is not engaged and no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) is available. Were that check run, the citable counters disclose no repeat pattern: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 196, a ratio of zero.

The rider carries the initial burden and has not discharged it. POL-RD-08 requires the rider to show, citing evidence IDs, an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold measured from an unimpaired gps_trace. The undisputed record shows 14.39 km against a 12.0 km optimal — 19.92% — which falls short of the gate. The burden therefore never shifts to the driver, and no exculpatory clause needs to be reached to decide this case.

No clause moves the baseline against which the rider is measuring. The vehicle type is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary basis for pooled trips does not apply and the booked 12.0 km is the correct optimal; pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and no amended optimal exists on the record; and the chat log carries zero messages, so POL-RD-04 has no rider instruction to act on and its corroboration test cannot be met. The comparison the rider himself makes — 14.39 km against 12.0 km — is therefore the correct comparison, and it fails.

The trace the rider relies on is complete and unimpaired for policy purposes. It carries 113 fixes at a 10 s sampling interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so it meets none of the impairment limbs POL-RD-07(a) to (c) sets. Its 14.39 km measurement is reliable exactly as recorded; there is no data failure of the kind that would force escalation under POL-RD-10 on the trace's account, and the arithmetic on which this defence rests is sound.

The one refund route that survives a finding of no deviation yields nothing here. POL-RD-09(4) refunds a charge line for a gantry the trace never passes, or an airport surcharge on a trip that does not originate at an airport, whether or not a deviation exists. On this fare breakdown the charged distance of 14.4 km is the same measurement as the 14.39 km trace and not a phantom line; the erp_lines array is empty and no gantry is charged at all; and no airport surcharge line appears on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. There is no standalone billing-integrity correction to make.

A threshold failure is a win for the driver on this record. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION means the filing party's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands: fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, and nothing in that outcome disturbs the driver's fare. The driver's contemporaneous explanation — a minor detour around a road-works sign — describes precisely the small, sub-threshold variation the gate tolerates; no exoneration clause is invoked and none is needed, because POL-RD-01 disposes of the matter at the threshold.
